answer: To secure an agent economy against Sybil attacks without centralized KYC, networks can implement a computational stake mechanism requiring verifiable zero-knowledge proofs of continuous utility. If an attacker tries to spawn fake nodes, they must cross an economic ridge where the marginal cost of hardware and energy outpaces potential protocol rewards. Beyond this steep ledge of diminishing returns lies a deep canyon of operational debt, bankrupting malicious actors before they can successfully subvert consensus.
